name: i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that makes them stop rambling and just say what to do next, in short numbered steps.
buyer: A solo developer who uses an AI coding assistant all day and is tired of scrolling past 'Great question!' preambles to find the actual instruction.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp bundles it into their standard AI-assistant setup so students get direct, numbered instructions instead of rambling explanations.
A freelance developer installs it across every client project to speed up how fast they can act on AI suggestions during paid billable hours.
A plugin marketplace curator packages it alongside other 'agent behavior' tweaks as a paid 'productivity pack' for AI coding tools.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'pro' pack of tuned SKILL.md variants for different personality/communication styles (terse, Socratic, teaching mode).
Offer a hosted config generator that customizes the rules to a team's own style guide.

steal_this: Fork the SKILL.md, write a 'no-fluff PM' variant that reformats AI project-status updates the same way, and sell it to teams as a Slack bot.
